guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build process fails at the step where pip, setuptools, and wheel are upgraded inside the system Python environment. The error message is: 'failed to export layer: CreateDiff: mount callback failed ... lstat ... /usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/packaging/__pycache__/requirements.cpython-311.pyc: no such file or directory'. This error suggests that there is a problem when Docker tries to export the file system changes after installing the updated packages. The root cause appears related to the permission or overlay filesystem issues during the pip upgrade of system packages located outside of the virtual environment. To fix this, do not upgrade pip/setuptools/wheel globally in the system Python environment. Instead, after creating the Python virtual environment, upgrade pip/setuptools/wheel inside the virtual environment. Adjust the Dockerfile to first create and activate the virtual environment, then run 'pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel' to avoid conflicts with system-installed versions. This avoids interference with the system Python and any permission conflicts during image layering.
